name: A Picture Worth Everything
source:
A surreal visual novel about a schoolgirl named Mira who can see an angel and a devil. They speak of a war over a garden. Can she ever escape her delusions?

[From [url=https://teacvp-snail.itch.io/a-picture-worth-everything]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部超现实主义视觉小说，讲述女学生米拉能够看见一位天使与一只恶魔。它们口中谈论着一场围绕某座花园展开的战争。米拉究竟能否逃离自己的妄想？

[摘自[url=https://teacvp-snail.itch.io/a-picture-worth-everything]itch.io[/url]]
